pages.title: 1. What needs to be connected
lines: BMW Wi-Fi carries the picture. Keep it switched on.
BMW Bluetooth media or Android Auto carries sound.
Park the car in P before starting the mirror.

pages.title: 2. Switch on BMW Wi-Fi
lines: In iDrive, open COM / Communication > Mobile devices.
Move the controller right, then open Settings.
Turn on Wi-Fi. Labels vary with BMW software.

pages.title: 3. Find the BMW network
lines: Mobile devices > New device > Internet, apps.
The car shows its Wi-Fi name and password, if equipped.
Some versions show these under Mobile devices > Settings.
Already on BMW Wi-Fi through Android Auto? Keep that link.

pages.title: 4. Join from your phone
lines: Samsung: Settings > Connections > Wi-Fi.
Select the network name shown by the BMW; enter its password.
If warned that it has no Internet, choose Stay connected.
Use the same BMW network, not garage Wi-Fi or a phone hotspot.

pages.title: 5. Connect the sound
lines: iDrive: COM > Mobile devices > your phone.
Enable Bluetooth audio and select it under MEDIA / Radio.
On the phone, allow Media audio for the BMW Bluetooth device.
Or keep your working Android Auto sound connection.

pages.title: 6. Pair once and start
lines: Phone app: Start sharing, then approve the entire screen.
Car app: Pair phone. Enter just the six-digit phone code.
The car finds the phone on the same BMW Wi-Fi network.
Pair once; starting on the phone then starts the chosen screen.

pages.title: 7. If the phone is not found
lines: Check that both devices use the same BMW Wi-Fi network.
Some BMW networks block automatic discovery.
Phone app: Manual pairing address. Car: Settings > Manual pairing.
Enter the address/code shown by the phone, including the slash.

pages.title: 8. If sound slows the picture
lines: Phone app > Display > Sound coexistence > Audio priority.
Keep BMW Wi-Fi connected while Bluetooth sound is playing.
Use 5 GHz only if your factory BMW menu offers that choice.
After an address change, restart sharing; the car reconnects.

notes: The mirror uses a local Wi-Fi link. BMW Internet/data subscriptions are separate.
Internet access for online videos depends on your phone or BMW data connection.
The app never changes the BMW Wi-Fi channel or audio routing automatically.
